currencyRates.title: Currency rates
currencyRates.description: Configure how currency exchange rates are managed
currencyRates.autoUpdateDescription: When enabled, rates are pulled daily from an external API and manual rate editing is disabled.

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: Control how users sign in to Savvy
authentication.passwordLoginLocked: Add and enable at least one SSO provider first. Otherwise everyone could be locked out.
authentication.passwordLoginOpen: When off, users can only sign in through SSO. Active sessions stay signed in.
authentication.passwordLoginError: Enable at least one SSO provider before turning off password sign-in.
authentication.jit: Create accounts on first SSO sign-in
authentication.jitDescription: When off, only existing or linked users can sign in.
authentication.verifiedEmailOn: New SSO sign-ups must arrive with an email the provider has verified.
authentication.verifiedEmailOff: Turn on just-in-time provisioning to enforce this.
authentication.requireVerificationOn: Users with an unconfirmed address can sign in but cannot use the app until they open the link we email them. Accounts created from a link copied out of the app start unconfirmed.
authentication.requireVerificationNeedsMail: Set up mail and the public URL first: confirmation links are sent by email.
authentication.requireVerificationNeedsYou: Confirm your own email address first, or you would lock yourself out.

server.title: Server
server.description: How this instance is reached from outside.
server.appUrlDescription: Full address users open Savvy at, e.g. https://savvy.example.com. Needed for SSO and passkeys. Can also be set as app_url in config.toml. Changing between http and https signs everyone out, so open Savvy at the new address.
server.configReadOnly: Savvy can't write to config.toml, so this can't be changed here. Set app_url in the file and restart.

mail.title: Email
mail.description: Sends password reset links and invitations.
mail.enabledDescription: Off keeps the settings below but sends nothing; links are shown to copy instead.
mail.userHint: Leave empty for a relay without login.
mail.passwordHint: Stored in config.toml in plain text; never shown again.
mail.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password
mail.fromHint: Name and address the emails come from.
mail.skipVerifyDescription: Only for a server with a self-signed certificate.
mail.timeoutHint: How long to wait for the server.
mail.configReadOnly: Savvy can't write to config.toml, so mail can't be changed here. Edit the [mailer] section in the file and restart.
mail.noAppUrl: The public URL is not set. Links in emails need it.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.invitesRegisterDescription: Someone without an account can register through an invitation link. People invited by a non-administrator become guests.
spaces.maxSpacesDescription: How many spaces a user can administer. Empty = no limit, 0 = none. Administrators have no limit.
spaces.quotaDescription: For every space without its own limit. 0 is unlimited.
spaces.backupsMaxDescription: Older backups of a space are removed. 0 keeps all.

invitations.title: Invitation cooldown
invitations.description: After an invitation to an address is revoked or runs out, that address cannot be invited again for one to two hours, so nobody can be flooded with emails. Clear the wait here.

password.title: Password
password.description: Change your password. Other devices will be signed out.
password.ssoOnly: This account signs in with SSO and does not use a password.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Sign out of every other device
sessions.logoutOthersDescription: Other browsers and devices will need to sign in again. This one stays signed in.
sessions.confirmDescription: Every other session will be revoked. You will stay signed in here.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Require a verification code in addition to your password
twoFactor.authenticatorDescription: Use a TOTP app such as Google Authenticator or Authy to generate sign-in codes.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in without a password using biometrics, a screen lock, or a security key
passkeys.deleteDescription: This passkey will no longer be able to sign in to your account.
passkeys.domainHint: Passkeys need HTTPS or localhost and a real domain. IP addresses don't work.
passkeys.addDescription: Give this passkey a name so you can recognize it later, then follow your browser's prompt.
passkeys.namePlaceholder: e.g. MacBook Touch ID, iPhone, YubiKey

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.description: Single-use codes to access your account if you lose your authenticator
recovery.remaining: {{count, plural(one: # code remaining; other: # codes remaining)}}. Regenerating invalidates the old set.
recovery.regenerateDescription: This invalidates all existing recovery codes. Enter a code from your authenticator app to continue.

dialogs.enableDescription: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.)
dialogs.verifyDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to confirm setup.
dialogs.recoveryDescription: Store these codes in a safe place. Each works once.
dialogs.disableDescription: Enter a verification code to disable 2FA. You can use a code from your authenticator app or a recovery code.

providers.title: Identity providers
providers.description: Configure OIDC and SAML single sign-on
providers.deleteDescription: This action cannot be undone. "{{name}}" will be permanently removed.
providers.emptyDescription: Let your team sign in with accounts they already have: Microsoft, Google, GitHub, Okta or any OIDC or SAML provider. Endpoints are pre-filled for the popular ones.
providers.quickSetupDescription: Pick a provider and connect it in seconds. Endpoints and scopes are pre-filled.
providers.connectionDescription: How Savvy talks to your identity provider
providers.provisioningDescription: What happens when someone signs in through this provider
providers.roleMappingDescription: Assign roles from IdP claims. The first matching rule wins
providers.noRules: No rules yet. Everyone gets the default role above.
providers.previewHidden: Hidden. Enable it to show on the sign-in screen
providers.registerUrls: Register these URLs in your identity provider.

import.title: Import transactions
import.description: Import transactions from a CSV file
import.readOnlyDescription: You don't have permission to import transactions. Ask an administrator for write access.
import.dropzone: Drop CSV file here or click to browse
import.sampledNote: Large file: checked a sample of {{sampled}} of {{total}} rows. Exact created and skipped counts are shown after the import runs.

backups.title: Backups

statusHelp.current: This backup’s schema matches the running app.
statusHelp.unsigned: This backup was made elsewhere or edited, so its signature isn't trusted here. You can still restore it.
statusHelp.invalid: This file is not a database Savvy can read.

backups.createDescription: Create a new backup of the current database.
backups.uploadDescription: Upload a backup archive (.zip) or a database file (.sqlite).

laravel.intro: This is a database from the Laravel version. It will be upgraded to the current format and saved as a backup. Your file is not kept, so keep your own copy. Nothing changes until you restore that backup. Choose what to upgrade it for.

server.title: The whole server
server.description: Saves a server backup with the old users, spaces and settings. Restoring it replaces everything on this server, and you will have to sign in with an account from the old database.

space.title: This space
space.description: Saves a backup of this space with the old finances. Restoring it replaces the data of this space. Users are not imported.

new.title: A new space
new.description: Creates a new space with the old finances and makes you its admin. Users are not imported.

laravel.appKeyHint: From the .env of the old install. Used to decrypt two-factor secrets. Without it, two-factor is switched off for those users and they sign in with a password only.

backups.restoreDescription: This will replace all current data with the backup from {{date}}. This action cannot be undone.
backups.deleteDescription: This will permanently delete the backup from {{date}}.

api.title: API
api.heading: API access
api.description: Connect external apps and scripts to your Savvy instance

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: Each connected app gets its own token. Revoke it any time.
tokens.editAria: Change what the token may do
tokens.revokeDescription: Apps using "{{name}}" will immediately lose access.

create.title: New API token
create.description: Name the app that will use this token.
create.name: Name
create.spacesHint: The token cannot see any other space.
create.permissionsDetails: Permissions by part of a space
create.permissionsHint: Grant only what the app needs. It can never do more than your own role in a space allows.

edit.title: Change {{name}}
edit.description: The app keeps working with the new rights from its next request. Nothing has to be connected again.
edit.hint: Taking something away cuts the app off from it at once. It can never do more than your own role in a space allows.

created.title: Copy your token
created.description: This is the only time it is shown. Store it somewhere safe.

spaces.allHint: Including spaces you join or create later. Leave it off to choose.

presetHint.viewer: Reads everything in the chosen spaces and changes nothing.
presetHint.editor: Can read all and edit almost everything.
presetHint.admin: Reads, changes and deletes everything in the chosen spaces. Space administration, backups and security stay with you.
presetHint.custom: Choose what the token may do for each part of a space.

sync.title: Space synchronisation
sync.mirrored: {{space}} keeps its {{kind}} identical with {{others}}: what this token changes there changes in those spaces too.
sync.unreachable: {{space}} keeps its {{kind}} identical with {{others}}, which this token cannot reach. It will be refused when it tries to change them in {{space}}. Choose those spaces too, or leave categories and tags out.
sync.hidden: {{count, plural(one: # space you are not a member of; other: # spaces you are not a member of)}}

intro.members: You can invite members to it and give each a role.
intro.separate: Spaces are separate from each other. You can switch between them at any time.

copy.hint: A one-time copy. The spaces stay independent. Anything not copied starts from the defaults.

spaces.privacy: Only names, members and sizes are shown here. Making yourself admin of a space shows in its audit log.
spaces.deletedDescription: Final backups of deleted spaces, kept for 30 days. Restoring creates a new space you administer.

mcp.description: Let an AI app such as Claude connect to this server and read your data. New apps can only register while you allow it, for a few minutes and for one app at a time.

mcp.allow: Allow a new app for 5 minutes
mcp.endpoint: Server address to add in the app

apps.title: Registered apps
apps.help: Every app a user has connected must first be allowed by that user on the consent page. Check the address an app registered from. The address is what the server saw, so behind a proxy it is only as reliable as the proxy's headers.
apps.removeDescription: The app and every connection it holds are deleted at once. It has to register again, which needs a new window.

app_url_missing.description: Invitation and password links point nowhere, and AI apps cannot connect.

mail_off.title: Email is not set up
mail_off.description: The server cannot send invitations or password links. Share the links by hand.

mail_invalid.title: Email settings are invalid
mail_invalid.description: Email is switched off until the [mailer] section of the config file is fixed.

backup_missing.title: No server backup yet
backup_missing.description: Backups are made by hand. Without one, a lost disk loses every space.

backup_stale.title: {{count, plural(one: Last server backup is # day old; other: Last server backup is # days old)}}
backup_stale.description: Backups are made by hand. Make a new one to keep recent changes safe.

disk_filling.description: Uploads and backups need room. Free some space or move the data directory.

config_read_only.title: Config file is read-only
config_read_only.description: Settings kept in config.toml, such as the public URL and email, cannot be changed here.
